title: Riemann-Hilbert Problem with non-analytic data
exact_target: Extend nonlinear steepest descent for oscillatory Riemann--Hilbert problems to phases with only finitely many derivatives.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 8000003 (AMR-079-0003). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Percy Deift, Some open problems in random matrix theory and the theory of integrable systems (2007), arXiv:0712.0849, Problem 3.

status_qualification: This method-development problem leaves the minimal differentiability and error estimates to be determined. The source mentions Miller--McLaughlin and Varzugin work as partial context, not as a general solution.
